Manifest.Name: Gunsmith Expansion
Manifest.Author: mazz
Manifest.Description: Underground gunsmithing for Probably Stolen. - 8 new guns, 14 attachments drawn on the gun. - 3D printing for the new guns, a refurbishing bench, ammo cases and 4 crates. - Vex's Night Armory: her stock follows your gun permits or your Black Market Reputation. Contracts, an order book, events and a phone line. - A Clandestine Gunsmith start and 6 perks. In English, French and Simplified Chinese.
